hypothesis.thinking: R1 global family: mean_shift=-40.9 (all-RGB same dir) + chroma_ratio=2.58 -> darken shift HSV + saturate strengthen HSV; severity from |mean_shift|/0.07 heuristic=3 and chroma formula caps at 5

R2 global severity calibration: R1 impulse_pct_zero diff=-20.2 -> sim zero-flood 45% vs target 25%, so saturate_strengthen_HSV:5 (S*64) far too strong; drop to sev2 (S*6). Keep darken sev3 (target clipped_fraction=0.25 pre-blur consistent with V-0.3 clipping).
R3 add blur per decision tree: glass_score=0.72>0.25 + sigma<3 -> glass; severity 5 from gm_ratio=0.329. Physical order brightness->blur->saturation.

R4 blur control: glass at sev5 already matches hf_lf_ratio (diff 0.003) but PSNR flat at 14 -> test deterministic gaussian (no shuffle randomness) at severity 3 (sigma=3, gm_ratio~0.33 calibration) as cross-family control.

R5 saturation variant: target unique counts (216-239) are only ~15% below clean, but HSV-sat sims collapse to ~126 -> HSV S-scaling clips channels and destroys uniques. YCrCb sat (c=3, chroma_ratio~2.58 match) is a smooth linear chroma scaling that preserves unique values.

R6 order test: with darken before blur, exact-zero fraction collapses to ~7% (blur sigma3 erodes clipped regions) while target keeps 25%. Physical rules allow brightness at priority=2 (ISP, post-blur). Move darken after blur to preserve the hard clipping.
R7 calibration from sim profile: gauss3 gm=0.162 vs target 0.329 -> gauss2; darkenHSV3 mean=-61.8 vs target -40.9 -> sev2 (c=0.2); YCrCb sat2 chroma=1.60 vs target 2.58 -> sev3 (c=5).

R8 saturation space: target has zero 255-clipped pixels but 25% zero-clipped -> chroma boost must preserve max channel (HSV S scaling) not symmetric YCrCb scaling (YCrCb3 sim made 9% white). Same blur/darken as T7 (gm 0.279 vs 0.329, slope -1.17 vs -1.14).

R9 single-global hypothesis: HSV S-scaling darkens RGB mean itself (T8: sat2 contributed ~-29 levels) while producing dark-side clipping only (no 255s, matching target). Test sat HSV sev3 alone to explain mean -40.9 + chroma 2.58 + var 1.32 without a brightness step.

R10 blur subtype: T9 (gauss2+sat3) fits all global signals (mean -44 vs -41, chroma 2.69 vs 2.58, spread 0.94 vs 0.94) but sim gm_ratio 0.27 vs 0.329 and zero_crossing_density low + overshoot low -> target retains more HF structure. Glass blur (shuffle) adds exactly such HF residual; test glass5 (sigma1.6+shuffle) as blur alternative per glass_score>0.25 rule.

R11 blur cross-family: with global fixed at satHSV3 (T9 fit), test lens disk blur radius=3 (sev2) as alternative to gaussian2 (gm 0.269 vs target 0.329 -> need slightly sharper blur); lens MTF has ripples that may explain target mtf_roughness=1.64 vs sim 1.37.

R12 JPEG masking test (should_still_test): block_boundary target 0.9935 vs sim ~0.98 -> if target carried JPEG the block signal would rise toward 1.0; test the only available mild JPEG (q25) after the deterministic steps. Expect clear PSNR drop if absent.

R13 blur severity scan: gm target 0.329; gauss2 0.269, lens2 0.306, glass5 0.211 -> glass4 (sigma1.4+shift3) should land near 0.33 while keeping glass shuffle HF residual (target glass_score 0.72, sims score >1.3 anyway).

R14 order fix: target overshoot_ratio=0.225 (low, smooth luma) vs HSV-sat sim 0.45 -> target saturation preserves Y (YCrCb chroma scaling). YCrCb3 alone caused 9% 255-clipping, but placing darken AFTER saturation removes those 255s and supplies the -41 mean shift + 25% dark clipping. Priority-2 steps (sat, ISP brightness) may be ordered either way.

R15 order: target Cr_local_std=9.08 vs clean 1.90 (x4.8 = YCrCb c=5), but sat-after-blur sims only reach 4.8-5.1 because blur first kills chroma detail. Saturate BEFORE blur restores x5 on full-detail chroma; early luma laplacian_var target 37.8 (T9 HSVsat=104, T14 YCCsat+darken=23) -> luma must be untouched by saturation. Darken last keeps the 25% hard zeros.

R16 darken severity: T14 same order with darkenHSV2 gave mean -34.6 (target -40.9), clip 0.181 (target 0.250), var 1.497 (target 1.316), spread 1.044 (target 0.943) -> all point to one notch stronger darken (c=0.3) while keeping sat->darken order that uniquely yields 0% white clipping like target.
R17: 复现当前最优确定性候选并获得完整 CI 指标明细。支持图像显示明显彩色颗粒 -> 需确认 3 个失败 CI 指标是否指向缺失噪声步骤。
R18: R17 的 zero_crossing_density 差 +0.146 (28%) 且 overshoot 差 -0.225 -> 目标含更多细颗粒。支持图可见彩色颗粒; 物理顺序 noise->blur->saturation。噪声估计 sigma~1.5-2.0 = sev1(12.75) 经 blur sigma2 衰减(~1.8)。
R19: 噪声存在 -> 切换信号验证。检查 sigma 误差、blur 谱斜率/Wiener 核、global mean/var/chroma 是否同时 MATCH。
R21: 高斯噪声在暗部过强(impulse_pct_zero/block_boundary/overshoot 均显示 sim 偏噪; support2 同模式)。Speckle 噪声乘性、强度相关, 暗部更弱, 可能同时修复暗部 clipping 与过冲。

R21: 顺序假设: sat 在 blur 前。目标 overshoot 低于 sat-after-blur sim (0.225 vs 0.36), 且 sim 暗部 clipping 偏多/过暗 4 级。若先 sat 后 blur, 模糊会平滑 posterize 硬边并抬升暗部均值, 预期 overshoot 与 impulse_pct_zero 同时改善; chroma 全局 std 仍保留。
R22: 1:1 裁剪对比显示目标平滑天空仅有轻微斑驳, 而 gauss/speckle sim 在天空过噪; 目标纹理区呈块状色斑。稀疏 impulse(1%) 经 blur 后形成块状噪声(非逐像素白噪), §B 残差 spatial_corr=0.81 亦支持空间相关噪声结构。

R23: 目标处于 blur->sat (R18: 0.366 overshoot/30% zero, 偏多) 与 sat->blur2 (R21: 0.10/7%, 偏少) 之间。若顺序为 sat->blur, 则 blur 应为 sev1: 保留部分 posterize 纹理与 25% 暗部 clipping, 同时不过度锐化。物理上 noise(传感器)->ISP sat->轻微光学/后期模糊 为合法 3 步。
R24: 目标天空颗粒自相关 FWHM=4px, 所有 sim=2px -> 目标颗粒更粗。更强 blur(sigma3) + 更强预模糊噪声(sev2) 可保持同等可见噪声幅度同时增大颗粒尺度, 并降低 std_lap (目标 6.15 vs sim 10.8) 与 overshoot。
R25 最终信号验证: 平坦区噪声随亮度增长 (1.90->2.47->4.58) 与 speckle (2.04->2.96->4.92) 吻合, gauss-YCrCb (1.69->2.06->3.25) 偏低; 天空 G 通道 5.96 vs 目标 5.81。信号模式复核 sigma/blur/global。

noise_6step_check.diagnosis: §B absolute thresholds are invalid here: 25% of channel values are clipped to 0, so the peeled residual is dominated by clipping mismatch (extreme_pct 60-61% = known IMPULSE false positive when extreme>50% and sigma<5; variance/vm slopes inflated). Noise PRESENCE is proven independently: flat-sky high-pass sigma target G=5.81 vs no-noise sim 0.56 (10x). Type from intensity dependence of flat-region noise: target rises 1.90->2.47->4.58 across bright bins, matching speckle (2.04->2.96->4.92) while gaussian-YCrCb is too flat/weak in highlights (1.69->2.06->3.25). => noise_speckle:1 (sev1 is the only level whose post-blur amplitude matches).

final_decision.rationale: 3-step pipeline locked by (a) compression absent (bb=0.9935; JPEG hurts CI), (b) blur present (gm 0.329, slope ratio 1.113), (c) noise present (flat-sky sigma 10x clean; no-noise sim fails ZCD by 28%), (d) single global step must explain mean -0.160 AND chroma 2.58 AND zero-clipping 25% -> only saturate_strengthen_HSV:3. Order noise->blur->saturation verified against alternatives: sat-before-blur removes the 25% dark clipping (7% vs 25%) and kills ZCD (41% low), while blur-before-sat matches both. Remaining systematic offsets (sim ~4 levels darker, var +0.12, zero-clipping +5pp) are consistent with a slightly stronger effective saturation than the GT; no legal discrete severity improves all three simultaneously.
